title: Next 30 years a danger time in the Taurid stream

tellings.quote: scientists from the comet research group he points that out that the next 30 years are a danger time

plain: The next 30 years are a dangerous time for Earth as it passes through the Taurid stream, a band of comet debris the planet crosses every year, according to scientists from a team called the Comet Research Group. The writer Graham Hancock passes this on from that group and from one of its scientists, Allen West. If they are right, Earth could face a serious impact from that debris within a generation.
